# Surgery Surgery lets you operate directly on a patient's body parts and organs rather than treating them with chemicals alone.
To begin, the patient must be lying down and you must be targeting the body part you want to work on. Select a surgery from the list, then work through its steps in order. Each step needs a specific tool, and skipping ahead is not possible.
Anesthetic makes the process far safer. An awake patient will be in considerable pain, which can interrupt the operation.
## Getting started - Put the patient on a bed, table, or operating table. - Choose the body part you want to operate on. - Interact with the patient using a surgical tool to open the surgery menu.
See the sub-sections for the specific procedures available.
